notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.9.2.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Warfare 1944 (v0.9.2.0).


Optimized Utah Beach map.
Fixed tree collision issues.
Fixed projectile collision issues with vegetation.
Removed Japanese Rifleman kit restriction.
Replaced items in all Japanese kits with their appropriate items.
Fixed up bullet flyby sfx when being suppressed.
Resolved issues with med and ammo bags not functioning properly with new aura-based behavior.
Added missing bandage animations.
Added missing bandages to Japanese faction.
Adjusted M1 Garand weapon fire animation blend values to not be so exaggerated.
Added crawling and prone transition sounds.
Fixed Sound Attenuation for ADS, Equip, and Prone animations.
Tweaked motion blur fps target to use a rolling average of the current frame rate rather than being locked to 30 fps by default in order to prevent excess smearing and other graphical artifacts.
Disabled spawn points for CPs that are under attack/have a defensive objective to allow for more of an Invasion-style game mode.
Updated AAS layouts for Carentan, Guadalcanal, and Utah maps.
Made various terrain and foliage edits to Carentan and Guadalcanal maps.
Made atmosphere improvements to Wake Island map.
Implemented singleplayer main menu screen, containing a basic map selection list for offline play.
Added "Report Bug" main/pause menu option for more convenient bug submission.
Added remappable key binding for Radial Menu toggle.
Fixed a rare issue where the game could freeze when at a loading screen.


Known Issues

Fingers clip through bandages.
Deployables may not properly replenish themselves after use and cannot be deployed again from the same kit as a result.
Rally Points that are placed in odd or hard-to-reach spots may not be spawnable.
Chat messages that are too long in length will get cut off and not be fully displayed in the UI.
Players can suppress themselves by shooting at their feet.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.9.0.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Warfare 1944 (v0.9.0.0).

General

Improved CPU utilization on systems with fewer than 4 cores.
Various tweaks and polish to pre-existing UI elements.


Squads and Platoons

Added platoons that are configured per-map or per-mode.
Added user-created squads.


Player Movement

Implemented leaning movement mechanic.
Implemented prone movement mechanic.


Weapons and Items

Added self-use bandages to all kits (see known issues).
Added Un-Equip animations, sounds to all classes and factions.
Added team and squad usage prerequisites to all kits.


Deployables

Added a placeholder implementation of outposts.
Added new radial menu interface that is used to place down outposts and rally points.
Use an aura effect while an ammo or medic bag is held rather than placing them on the ground.


Effects

Added tracer effects
Added suppression effect when player is taking fire
Added new muzzle flash effects
Added new smoke grenade effects


Text Comms

Added squad-only text comm channel.
Global chat messages from enemies appear with a red color while messages from friendlies appear with a blue color.


VoIP Comms

Greatly improved overall stability of the VoIP system.
Implemented team-local, squad-only, and squad leader-only/command comm channels.
Fixed an issue where a VoIP indicator listing could remain onscreen long after the player has stopped talking.
Fixed a crash that could occur if players were speaking prior to a map change.


Known Issues

Enabled bandages to be selectable, though the bandage animations are broken.
Deployables may not properly replenish themselves after use and cannot be deployed again from the same kit as a result.
Rally Points that are placed in odd or hard-to-reach spots may not be spawnable.
Chat messages that are too long in length will get cut off and not be fully displayed in the UI.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.8.9.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Warfare 1944 (v0.8.9.0).

Player Movement

Implemented basic surface-level swimming movement mechanics
Minor character movement client-to-server bandwidth optimizations


Deployables

Fixed most common cases of players not being able to spawn from rally points that have been deployed from their team due to world geometry collision issues.
Med bags and ammo bags now contain a quantity of 3 rather than 1 before item cooldown.


RCON

Added padding for "status" command output text.
Print map and game mode package names in addition to friendly/display names in "status" command output text.
Clarify that "Players" number reflects the number of Human Players and is not a total that includes bot count by default in "status" command output text.


User Interface

Tweaked alignment of on-screen player nametags.


Known Issues

Deployables may not properly replenish themselves after use and cannot be deployed again from the same kit as a result.
Rally Point deployable does not currently possess third-person animations and thus does not display correctly from this perspective.
Rally Points that are placed in odd or hard-to-reach spots may not be spawnable.
A crash may occur on some clients after a map change, related to VoIP system usage.
Some VoIP indicator listings that appear on the HUD may get stuck and not disappear despite the player having stopped talking.
Chat messages that are too long in length will get cut off and not be fully displayed in the UI.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.8.8.0 Update Released

The symbol denoting a player's currently equipped kit is now visible both on their nametag and on their VoIP indicator listing if they are currently talking over voice in-game.
Fixed an issue where capture point icons on the spawn map would not properly align to their physical counterparts in the world.


Deployables

Implemented Med and Ammo Bags
Implemented Rally Points


Weapons

M1Garand and Kar98  14 -> 6 clips
Thompson and MP40 12 -> 5 mags
M1911 and Luger 6-> 3 mags
BAR and STG44 10 -> 6 mags
M1Carbine and G43 12 -> 6 mags
Bazooka and Panzerfaust 4 -> 2 rockets
30cal and MG42 5 -> 3 belts


Foliage

Improved collision on Trees


Carentan

Fixed wall collision on stone and wood fences


Guadalcanal

Fixed Bambo Fence Collision 


Known Issues

Deployables may not properly replenish themselves after use and cannot be deployed again from the same kit as a result.
Rally Point deployable does not currently possess third-person animations and thus does not display correctly from this perspective.
Rally Points that are placed in tight spots may not be spawnable.
A crash may occur on some clients after a map change, related to VoIP system usage.
Some VoIP indicator listings that appear on the HUD may get stuck and not disappear despite the player having stopped talking.
Chat messages that are too long in length will get cut off and not be fully displayed in the UI.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.8.7.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Warfare 1944 (v0.8.7.0).

General

Fixes to some game freeze/hang issues that can occur when there is a lot of impact fx being spawned and destroyed at once.
Added some new weapon and deploy icons.


Projectiles/Hit Detection

Implemented client-side prediction for projectiles.
Some more adjustments were made to hit detection in order to improve consistency.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.8.6.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Warfare 1944 (v0.8.6.0).

Projectiles/Hit Detection

Projectiles have been completely reworked for an improved experience.
First iteration of improved hit detection system for projectiles. Client shots should register a bit more consistently on the server.
Optimized bandwidth usage and server replication performance of all live and newly-spawned projectiles.
Further bandwidth usage and server replication performance optimizations for fast-moving/bullet-like projectiles.
Improved synchronization between client and server projectile instances.
Resolved issues with smoke fx/amount of smoke from an active smoke grenade being out of sync for clients that were not present in the area when the smoke grenade had initially activated.
Reduced lifespan of smoke grenade projectiles that would remain active long after the smoke fx had finished.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 0.8.1.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Warfare 1944 (v0.8.1.0).

General

Team Auto-Balance feature now moves players based on time spent on their current team by default rather than moving players arbitrarily (favors least time when choosing).
Removed some CVars that players could modify to allow for an unfair advantage.


Server Administration

Added "ForceTeam" and "ForceTeamId" console commands for admins to use for switching individual players between teams manually.


Audio

Added new Mid and Far Gunshot Audio.
Added Mid and Far Grenade Explosion Audio.


Utah

Adjusted Culling Distances for all assets to accommodate for Low Quality Settings.
Optimized Terrain Tile Level Bounds for performance.
Moved Water Blueprints from Main sublevel to the level they reside on.
Increased LOD distances for foliage.
Removed normals from all Terrain LODs.
Reduced all Terrain LOD Texture sizes for performance.
Optimized Terrain LOD Materials.
Assigned Terrain tiles to a smaller streaming distance for performance.
Fixed several floating props and foliage.
Fixed floating hedgerows and mounds.
Fixed floating fences.


Carentan

Adjusted Culling Distances to accommodate for Low Quality Settings.


Wake Island

Adjusted Culling Distances for better performance.


Firing Range

Adjusted Culling Distances on all assets to accommodate for Low Quality Settings.
